asr_text: This episode looks at why the same personalized news feed can feel helpful to one reader and troubling to another. We will explore the balance between getting relevant news quickly and seeing how the feed shapes what appears. By the end, you will be able to ask a clearer question: What does personalization give us, and what might it hide?
